scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w backend && npm run coverage -w frontend
